description: OSC routing schema for TouchDesigner ↔ Blender ↔ Unreal Engine bridge. All agents reference this schema. Port 9000 is SINGLE source of truth for TD↔UE (TD CHOP bass/mid/treble + UE beat_pulse/beat_phase). Do NOT create second channel on 9870.

melusina_pitch.description: VoiceSynth fundamental frequency → UE shader warp amount

melusina_amplitude.description: VoiceSynth RMS amplitude → UE particle spawn rate

melusina_formants.description: VoiceSynth formant analysis → TD particle color palette

toon_params.description: TD → UE Substrate Toon parameter group (12 floats, MPC-mapped): [0]bloom_intensity→Magical.BloomIntensity, [1]bloom_threshold→PP, [2]sparkle_pulse→SakuraDream.SparklePulse, [3]dream_intensity→SakuraDream.DreamIntensity, [4]wind_strength→SakuraDream.WindStrength, [5]global_opacity→SakuraDream.GlobalOpacity, [6]shadow_tint_r→PP, [7]shadow_tint_b→PP, [8]magical_transform→Magical.MagicalTransform, [9]saturation→PP, [10]diffuse_wrap→Material, [11]sparkle_visibility→SakuraDream.SparkleVisibility

fabric_specular.description: Fabric material params: [roughness, anisotropy, clearcoat, sheen_weight] for satin/velvet rendering

beat_sync.description: Music beat synchronization phase (normalized to beat duration)

time_of_day_seconds.description: Absolute time of day in seconds (0-86400)

blender_camera_transform.description: Blender camera Z-up world matrix (4x4, column-major)

grade.description: Rhythm hit result: perfect|great|good|miss — drives VFX intensity in TD

combo.description: Current combo count — particle density multiplier in TD

enemy_broken.description: Enemy toughness broken (0/1) — triggers wish burst in TD

ult_gauge.description: Ultimate gauge 0-100 — drives glow intensity in TD

encounter.description: Enemy ID + BPM + element when encounter starts

result.description: Battle result: victory|defeat|fled — triggers finale VFX in TD

beat_pulse.description: Continuous beat-synced pulse from UMelodiaRhythmReactivitySubsystem — decays from 1.0 at 6x DeltaTime on each beat. Drives TD bloom overlay opacity.

beat_phase.description: Continuous normalized position within current beat (0.0-1.0), streamed every tick from UMelodiaRhythmReactivitySubsystem::Publish(). Identical to beat_progress but firehose-rate (every frame, not just per-beat).

sparkle_rate.description: Sakura sparkle particle spawn rate multiplier

burst_trigger.description: Wish burst trigger (0→1 edge fires burst)

wind.description: Wind direction vector affecting all Niagara systems

mesh_count.description: Number of generated meshes in current export batch

vertex_count.description: Total vertex count for generated geometry

bass.description: TD CHOP bass RMS 20-250Hz (audiofilter low-pass + analyze RMS + math gain 2x + lag 0.1/0.35) → UE MPC_Melodia_Palette.Bass → flower petal scale 1.0+0.15*bass. Sent from TD oscoutCHOP on port 9000 via /project1/melodia_audio/osc_out.

mid.description: TD CHOP mid RMS 250-2000Hz (band-pass + RMS + lag) → UE MPC Mid → flower hue shift / stem sway (mid*0.01). Port 9000.

treble.description: TD CHOP treble RMS 2k-20kHz (high-pass + RMS + lag) → UE MPC Treble → emissive sparkle 0.6*treble. Port 9000.

beat_pulse.description: Continuous beat envelope from UMelodiaRhythmReactivitySubsystem::Publish() (NotifyBeat sets 1.0, decays 6*DT). UE→TD on port 9000. Alias of /rhythm/beat_pulse. Drives flower bloom via lag_beat_pulse 0.05. Also available as /rhythm/beat_pulse from C++.

beat_phase.description: Normalized position within current beat 0..1 from UMelodiaRhythmReactivitySubsystem. UE→TD on port 9000. Alias of /rhythm/beat_phase. Drives stem sin(phase*2PI)*0.02. Complemented by TD-side selectCHOP sel_beat_phase.

TD_NikkiPreview.description: TD composited Nikki-style preview with bloom, color grade, and particles

UE_RenderTarget.description: UE render target for real-time feedback to TD

Blender_Viewport.description: Blender viewport capture for live geometry preview in TD
